title: Mushrooms deco
description: A Mushroom deco pack, Using filament and polymer
body:
**THIS USES FILAMENT AND POLYMER YOU NEED TO BE USING THEM TO MAKE THIS FUNCTION**

---

Adds a few small mushroom decorations! 

Placing a Red mushroom in an stonecutter will let you craft a Red wallshroom which placing up to 4 in the same block will change how many appear.

Placing Glow lichen in a stonecutter Allows you to get hanging Glow liuchen! which uses a very similar texture to hanging pale moss!

Placing Vines in an stonecutter allows you to get Blooming vines!
